text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the outing. It was a 
meaningful way to refresh myself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I have my next schedule to 
attend to, so I shall take my leave here—
'Sup.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
5 minutes and 10 seconds before our 
meeting time. You're unusually early 
today, Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I had plans to hang out with 
Jordan-san. However...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san. I haven't heard where we are 
going today yet?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh. Was that it? Well, I totally didn't 
have a plan anyway.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No plan!? We made these plans to hang out 
a month ago, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't get so worked up. Karaoke's 
good for now, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You can't just be so haphazard about it... 
Jordan, plans are meant to be laid out 
systematically—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"No, I wasn't just throwing something out 
there! You know, 'karaoke for now' is 
basically part of Japanese culture, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Japanese culture?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Btw, this is totally common 
knowledge. So let's hurry up and get 
going.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you too, Trainer-san. It's way 
more fun with more people~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I sang so much. Flash-san, you're up 
next~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me. I was just pondering the 
cultural phenomenon of 'karaoke for the 
time being.'"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're stressing over *that*? Lol. It's 
totally not worth worrying about~

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I came to study abroad to learn about 
modern Japanese culture. ...Or rather, 
that's what I intended to do."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, it seems Japan's progress has 
outpaced even my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can make it... in this 
constantly changing Japan...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...N-No way... My mood totally dropped. 
Uh... what do I do?
choice_data_list: You can just learn as you go from now on.
You can just learn as you go from now on.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, yeah! Trends are something you 
learn just by trying 'em out!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Practice makes perfect. It's important 
to constantly immerse oneself in the 
latest culture. Is that what you mean?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then... I shall sing the number one J-POP 
song on the charts! 'L-Love's Hyped-Up 
Hill Climb'!
choice_data_list: Leave the backup chants to me!

You should pick a song you're used to 
singing.

text_block_list.text:
And thus, Eishin Flash began to sing a 
trendy J-POP song, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"‘Crazy in lo~ve’... Ah, the rhythm 
slipped 0.5 seconds off the main melody 
again—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"My heart is fluttering~!" Come on, 
Flash-san, hype it up, hype it up~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! "Running up together~♪"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, how was it? Your first time doing a 
casual karaoke trip?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see... I think I understand a bit now 
why "let's just hit karaoke for now" 
became such a thing in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
By making music so accessible, you're 
allowing culture to truly take root, 
aren't you?
choice_data_list: Well, we learned something right away.

Looks like we learned something right off 
the bat!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Phew, thank goodness... I was just talking 
out of my ass. I panicked so hard.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ……Appropriate, is it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Calling it "half-assed"... or 
"karaoke for now" is just part of the 
vibe, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "...Just 'kidding' (Jordan)? Like that?"

Afterward, Tosen Jordan received a proper, 
thorough scolding from Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally~. Rather than forcing it, wearing 
your heavy rotation stuff hypes you up way 
more, right?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well then... would a German children's 
song be alright? Those are about the only 
ones I'm used to singing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If it's a German nursery rhyme, they're 
sung in Japan too, so most likely.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A famous one is 'The Frog's Song,' isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real? That's a German song? Guess I 
can sing in German then.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, since we're here, wanna do a duet? 
In German and Japanese."
choice_data_list: I'd like to hear about that.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? If that's the case, I'll 
leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, how was it? Your first time doing a 
casual karaoke trip?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. It has given me a new task: to 
study modern customs."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If I had to sum up this emotion in one 
word—
choice_data_list: If you had to put it into words?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I had a lot of fun.
